source: ECOSORN project leaflet, "សណ្តែកសៀង (ពូជក្នុងស្រុក)" [Soybean (local varieties)], 2-page farmer extension leaflet
text: Planting, thinning, and weeding are covered together on one panel: seeds are sown at recommended row and plant spacing, seedlings are thinned to the target stand once established, and the field is weeded by hand or with simple tools during early growth so that young soybean plants (which are poor early competitors against weeds) are not shaded out or starved of nutrients before canopy closure.
